mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives forward-looking equity earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 indicates weakening real economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% and FEDFUNDS above 5.0% signal a persistent inflationary environment that triggers a hawkish monetary policy stance, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 157,000 and decline in UNRATE below 3.7% signals a labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 157000 and UNRATE < 3.7, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars signals strong aggregate demand, which drives corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 700,000, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 22,500 billion dollars signals strong underlying economic momentum, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 22,500, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
